svg.aria-label: How to make a Margarita, step by step: Salt the rim. Rub a lime wedge around the outside of the rim of a rocks glass, then roll it in coarse salt. Combine ingredients. Add the tequila, orange liqueur and lime juice to your shaker. Shake. Add ice and shake hard, until frosty cold. Pour it all in. Pour everything, ice and all, into the salted glass. Garnish. A lime wheel on the rim. Cheers!
